checklist.title: Prebook Aqua Luna Christmas sailing with Symphony of Lights
Prebook 07:30 TurboJET Sheung Wan → Macau Outer Harbour for Sunday 27 Dec
syncTitles: Prebook 07:30 TurboJET Sheung Wan → Macau Outer Harbour
checklist.description: Use Outer Harbour arrival because Fisherman's Wharf is beside the terminal and the historic centre comes next.

checklist.title: Prebook Macau Tower Bungy around 14:00–14:30 on Sunday 27 Dec
Prebook 23:00 Cotai Water Jet Taipa → Sheung Wan for Sunday 27 Dec
syncTitles: Prebook around 22:00 Taipa → Sheung Wan ferry
checklist.description: Current schedule also lists 22:00 and 23:59. Recheck December timetable before booking.

checklist.title: Prebook Ngong Ping 360 round-trip Crystal Cabin
syncTitles: Prebook Ngong Ping 360 one-way Crystal Cabin
checklist.description: Use the cable car both ways: Tung Chung → Ngong Ping in the morning and Ngong Ping → Tung Chung late afternoon.

checklist.title: Book Hong Kong Disneyland for 30 December
Recheck official NYE fireworks, crowd-control zones and MTR hours
Golden Reel only if Bungy finishes on time
syncTitles: Golden Reel if Bungy finishes on time and operating calendar permits
checklist.description: Optional. Skip first if the Macau day is running late; protect Venetian/Parisian/Londoner and Wynn Palace at night.

checklist.title: Take a short Tai O village boat ride if operating
Check tomorrow morning's Peak visibility
checklist.description: Check visibility, low cloud, mist and rain; do not overreact to generic December fog. If genuinely poor, continue Happy Valley → Central → Tai Kwun → PMQ → Star Ferry and reassess Peak later.

checklist.title: Buy two Adult On-Loan Octopus cards after arrival
checklist.description: Each starts with about HK$150 stored value; optionally top up HK$250–350 each.

checklist.title: Refund both On-Loan Octopus cards before departure
checklist.description: Deposit is refundable; early-return handling fee is approximately HK$11 or 1% of remaining value, whichever is higher.

checklist.title: Install Hong Kong transport apps on both phones
checklist.description: Install Citybus, APP1933/KMB, HK Tramways, MTR Mobile, HKeMobility; confirm Google Maps, WhatsApp and TripBoard work on both phones.

checklist.title: Set up and verify both SoSIM connections
checklist.description: Buy/activate both, complete real-name registration and verify mobile data.

checklist.title: Buy Macau roaming add-on and verify data
checklist.description: Buy before travel and confirm data works before leaving the ferry terminal if practical.

checklist.title: Arrange initial HKD cash and overseas card use
checklist.description: Target HK$1,500–2,000 combined; at ATM/card terminals choose HKD and decline INR conversion.

checklist.title: Macau documents, cash and ferry check
checklist.description: Carry both passports and Bungy confirmation; confirm ferries and roaming; carry small MOP cash; confirm Golden Reel only if interested.

checklist.title: Recheck Route 21, Route 23 and Ngong Ping festive conditions
syncTitles: Recheck Route 21, Route 11 and Ngong Ping conditions
checklist.description: Recheck Route 21 timetable, Bus 23 fallback, Ngong Ping 360 festive opening hours, maintenance/weather notices and expected queues before 29 Dec.

checklist.title: Recheck Disneyland 30 Dec operating hours and show times
Prepare for NYE crowd controls
checklist.description: Charge phones/power banks; carry water and warm layer; check weather, road closures, crowd controls, extended MTR and official countdown/fireworks arrangements.

checklist.title: Recheck Lee Tung Avenue 2026 Christmas / Let It Snow schedule
checklist.description: Confirm whether Let It Snow runs on 26 Dec 2026, exact show times, and any crowd-control notices. If the 2025 pattern repeats, target the first evening show and leave immediately after it for the Peak.

checklist.title: Recheck Boxing Day Peak queues and traffic
checklist.description: 26 Dec is a Hong Kong general holiday. Check Peak Tram queue reports, road traffic and any crowd-control notices. Keep the early morning tram visit; use road transport for the night Peak visit unless evening tram queues are clearly short.

checklist.title: Recheck Sunday Macau ferries, leisure buses and taxi/shuttle arrangements
checklist.description: Confirm 07:30 TurboJET outbound, 23:00 Cotai Water Jet return, Tourism and Leisure Bus routes, Wynn shuttle details and any holiday/festive transport changes.

checklist.title: See Wynn Palace Performance Lake at night
checklist.description: Current evening shows run every 20 minutes after 18:00. SkyCab is optional if queue/time allow.

checklist.title: Quick Macau Fisherman's Wharf stop after arrival
checklist.description: Free and about a 5-minute walk from Outer Harbour. Keep it to roughly 35–40 minutes.

itinerary.title: Vietnam Airlines VN982: Bengaluru to Hanoi (transit)
itinerary.transportInstructions: Departs Bengaluru Kempegowda International Airport, Terminal 2, at 23:35 on 24 Dec (arrives Hanoi Noi Bai Terminal 2 at 05:50 on 25 Dec). Economy Lite; seat 14E; one checked bag. Hindu meal request confirmed. This is the first leg of the Hong Kong journey, with a Hanoi transit, not a separate booking.

itinerary.title: Vietnam Airlines VN592: Hanoi to Hong Kong
itinerary.transportInstructions: Depart Hanoi Noi Bai International Airport, Terminal 2, at 10:35; arrive Hong Kong International Airport, Terminal 1, at 13:30. Economy Lite; seat 30A; one checked bag. Seafood meal request confirmed. Continuation of the Bengaluru → Hanoi → Hong Kong journey.

itinerary.title: Land at Hong Kong International Airport
itinerary.transportInstructions: Allow 60–90 minutes for immigration, baggage, toilets, SIM/eSIM if required, Octopus and cash/ATM.

details.quickNote: Clear immigration, collect bags, connect both phones, withdraw only a small amount of HKD if needed, then take A21. Do not buy Tourist/On-Loan Octopus at the airport by default.
details.payWith: Contactless card for A21; cash only as a backup.
details.fallback: Airport Express to Kowloon + taxi if road traffic or luggage convenience makes it worthwhile.

itinerary.title: A21 Airport Bus to Yau Ma Tei
itinerary.transportInstructions: Take A21 towards Kowloon and get off around Yau Ma Tei. Recommended with luggage; avoids MTR interchanges.

transportOptions.name: A21 airport bus
transportOptions.route: Airport Ground Transportation Centre → Nathan Road / Yau Ma Tei
transportOptions.notes: Direct and luggage-friendly.

transportOptions.name: Airport Express + taxi
transportOptions.route: Airport Express → Kowloon Station, then taxi to hotel
transportOptions.notes: Fastest practical option but much more expensive.

transportOptions.name: Airport Express + MTR
transportOptions.route: Airport Express → Hong Kong/Kowloon connection → Yau Ma Tei
transportOptions.notes: More transfers with luggage.

details.quickNote: After hotel check-in, buy two physical Adult On-Loan Octopus cards at Yau Ma Tei MTR. Each starts with about HK$150 stored value; optionally top up another HK$250–350 so each has roughly HK$400–500 available.

itinerary.title: Buy two Adult On-Loan Octopus cards
itinerary.transportInstructions: Buy at Yau Ma Tei MTR Customer Service Centre. Each card includes about HK$50 refundable deposit and HK$150 stored value; top up another HK$250–350 only if useful.

itinerary.title: Tsim Sha Tsui Christmas walk
itinerary.transportInstructions: Prefer Yau Ma Tei MTR → Tsim Sha Tsui to protect Aqua Luna timing. Walking via Jordan is a scenic option only when comfortably ahead. Prioritise harbour, Clock Tower, Star Ferry Pier, Avenue of Stars, Harbour City/K11 surroundings and Christmas installations.

transportOptions.name: MTR
transportOptions.route: Yau Ma Tei → Tsim Sha Tsui

transportOptions.name: Bus
transportOptions.route: Nathan Road southbound to Tsim Sha Tsui

itinerary.title: Aqua Luna and Symphony of Lights
itinerary.transportInstructions: Board at the Tsim Sha Tsui boarding point. Choose sailing including the 20:00 Symphony of Lights.

details.quickNote: The 60-minute calendar block includes boarding, sailing and disembarking; actual sailing may be shorter. Prebook the Christmas sailing that includes the 20:00 Symphony of Lights.

itinerary.title: Dinner around Tsim Sha Tsui / Jordan / Yau Ma Tei
itinerary.transportInstructions: Keep arrival-night dinner spontaneous. No beef and preferably no beef broth.

itinerary.title: Optional short Temple Street walk and snack
Travel to Peak Tram Central Terminus
itinerary.transportInstructions: Yau Ma Tei MTR → Central, then walk about 10–15 minutes to the Peak Tram terminus.

details.weather: Weather checkpoint: on 25 December evening, check Peak visibility, cloud base, rain and mist. Keep the early Peak plan when reasonably clear; otherwise make it movable and continue with Happy Valley/Central.
details.quickNote: Boxing Day is a Hong Kong general holiday. Wake about 06:15 and leave around 06:40. Early arrival is intentional to beat the much heavier holiday crowds expected later in the day.

transportOptions.name: MTR + walk
transportOptions.route: Yau Ma Tei → Central, then walk to Peak Tram Lower Terminus

transportOptions.name: Taxi
transportOptions.notes: Best fallback if running late.

transportOptions.name: MTR + short taxi
transportOptions.route: Yau Ma Tei → Central, then short taxi

details.crowdNote: 26 Dec is an official general holiday. Allow extra station/walking time and avoid shifting the morning Peak visit later unless weather forces it.

itinerary.title: Peak Tram up
itinerary.transportInstructions: Buy single journey UP only; descend later by Bus 15.

details.quickNote: Use the Peak Tram for the morning ascent while queues should be lighter. Current adult single fare is HK$82. Keep the night visit road-based to avoid paying for and queueing for the tram twice.
details.weather: First Peak visit is daylight / Lugard Road; Sky Terrace 428 is optional.

transportOptions.name: Peak Tram
transportOptions.route: Peak Tram Lower Terminus → The Peak

transportOptions.name: Green Minibus 1
transportOptions.route: Hong Kong Station Public Transport Interchange → The Peak

details.crowdNote: Holiday morning: arrive before opening/first rush; later Boxing Day queues can be materially longer.

itinerary.title: Victoria Peak and Lugard Road
itinerary.transportInstructions: Prioritise Lugard Road / part of Peak Circle Walk. Sky Terrace 428 is optional and not necessary if visibility is good.

details.quickNote: Daylight Peak visit: prioritise Lugard Road / Peak Circle views. Sky Terrace is optional.
details.crowdNote: Keep this efficient; the second Peak visit tonight is for skyline lights.

itinerary.title: Bus 15 down from The Peak
itinerary.transportInstructions: Take scenic Bus 15 down. It does not drop directly at Cheung Hing; allow an onward tram, bus, taxi or short walk to Happy Valley.

transportOptions.name: Bus 15
transportOptions.route: The Peak → Central / Wan Chai direction

details.crowdNote: Boxing Day buses can fill quickly. If the Bus 15 queue is visibly long, use Green Minibus 1 or taxi and continue to Happy Valley.

itinerary.title: Transfer to Happy Valley
itinerary.transportInstructions: Continue from the Bus 15 practical drop-off by tram, bus, taxi or a short walk as convenient.

transportOptions.route: Nearest tram stop → Happy Valley, then short walk

transportOptions.name: Taxi

itinerary.title: Cheung Hing Coffee Shop breakfast
itinerary.transportInstructions: Try pineapple bun, pineapple bun with butter, egg tart and Hong Kong milk tea.

itinerary.title: Happy Valley to Central by Ding Ding
itinerary.transportInstructions: Use Hong Kong Tramways for part of the journey; sit upstairs if possible.

transportOptions.name: Ding Ding
transportOptions.notes: Scenic; sit upstairs if possible.

transportOptions.name: MTR
transportOptions.route: Walk/bus to Causeway Bay MTR → Central

details.crowdNote: Holiday traffic can slow the tram; allow ~10–15 minutes of slippage without affecting the day.

itinerary.title: Central / Old Town walking route
itinerary.transportInstructions: Central streets, Mid-Levels Escalator, Graham Street, Old Town Central and Hollywood Road.

itinerary.title: Lunch around Central
itinerary.transportInstructions: Casual cha chaan teng / roast meat rice / pork or chicken noodles / baked pork chop rice / dim sum. Avoid beef/broth.

details.crowdNote: Boxing Day afternoon will likely be busy around Central festive displays. Treat 17:10 as a firm leave-by target.

itinerary.title: Central → Lee Tung Avenue
itinerary.transportInstructions: Move to Wan Chai before the evening festive crowd builds. Lee Tung Avenue is near Wan Chai MTR Exit D.

transportOptions.name: MTR + walk
transportOptions.route: Central → Wan Chai, Exit D → walk to Lee Tung Avenue

transportOptions.name: Ding Ding
transportOptions.route: Central → Wan Chai, then short walk
transportOptions.notes: Scenic but slower in Boxing Day traffic.

details.crowdNote: Prefer MTR over road transport if Central/Wan Chai traffic is heavy.

itinerary.title: Lee Tung Avenue Christmas lights + Let It Snow if confirmed

details.quickNote: See the Christmas installations, take an early dinner/snack nearby, and target the first snow show if the 2026 programme repeats the 2025 pattern.
details.planningAssumption: 2025 'Let It Snow!' shows were at 19:30, 20:30 and 21:30 on selected dates including Fridays/Saturdays and Christmas-period dates. The 2026 schedule is not yet announced.
details.crowdNote: Official 2025 material warned that crowd-control measures may be used during peak periods. If the 19:30 show is confirmed for 26 Dec 2026, be near Central Piazza by about 19:05–19:15 and leave after the first show.
details.fallback: If no 2026 snow show is scheduled, enjoy the lights briefly and leave earlier for the Peak.

itinerary.title: Lee Tung Avenue → Victoria Peak
itinerary.transportInstructions: This is Boxing Day evening. Do not default to the Peak Tram again: you already rode it in the morning and holiday queues can be substantial. Use the quickest practical road option.

transportOptions.name: Taxi
transportOptions.notes: Fastest door-to-door option if road traffic is moving.

transportOptions.name: MTR + Green Minibus 1
transportOptions.route: Wan Chai → Central/Hong Kong Station → Green Minibus 1 → The Peak
transportOptions.notes: Minibus 1 full fare is currently HK$11.80.

transportOptions.name: Bus 15
transportOptions.route: Get to a suitable Route 15 stop in Central/Admiralty → The Peak
transportOptions.notes: Cheapest direct road option but slowest in holiday traffic.

transportOptions.name: Peak Tram
transportOptions.route: Wan Chai → Peak Tram Lower Terminus → The Peak
transportOptions.notes: Not recommended for the second visit because Boxing Day evening queues may be long.

details.crowdNote: Build in ~20 minutes of holiday-delay margin. If road traffic looks severe, switch to MTR + Green Minibus 1 rather than waiting for a taxi.

itinerary.title: Victoria Peak night skyline
itinerary.transportInstructions: Focus on the night skyline. Keep this second Peak visit tighter than the morning visit.

details.quickNote: Peak Tram runs until 23:00 and Sky Terrace 428 currently closes at 22:00.
details.crowdNote: Boxing Day evening can be very busy. Free viewpoints are fine if Sky Terrace queues are not worth it.

itinerary.title: Victoria Peak → Central
itinerary.transportInstructions: Descend by road to avoid the Peak Tram holiday queue.

transportOptions.name: Green Minibus 1
transportOptions.route: The Peak → Hong Kong Station Public Transport Interchange

transportOptions.name: Peak Tram
transportOptions.route: The Peak → Peak Tram Lower Terminus
transportOptions.notes: Only use if the queue is clearly short.

details.crowdNote: If the minibus queue is too long, switch to Bus 15 or taxi.

itinerary.title: Star Ferry Central → Tsim Sha Tsui
itinerary.transportInstructions: Take the late Star Ferry back to Kowloon if you reach Central comfortably before the last service.

transportOptions.name: Star Ferry
transportOptions.approxCost: HK$6.50/person upper deck on public holiday
transportOptions.notes: Current public-holiday service runs until 23:30.

transportOptions.name: MTR
transportOptions.notes: Use if Peak descent runs late.

itinerary.title: Tsim Sha Tsui → hotel / late supper
itinerary.transportInstructions: Return to Yau Ma Tei/Jordan and eat only if still hungry after Lee Tung Avenue.

transportOptions.notes: Only if energy is good.

itinerary.title: Taxi to Hong Kong Macau Ferry Terminal
itinerary.transportInstructions: Use taxi from Yau Ma Tei because of the early Sunday start. Target the terminal by 06:35–06:45 for the 07:30 ferry.

transportOptions.name: Taxi
transportOptions.route: Yau Ma Tei → Hong Kong Macau Ferry Terminal, Sheung Wan

transportOptions.name: MTR
transportOptions.route: Yau Ma Tei → Central/Sheung Wan + walk
transportOptions.notes: Not recommended because first-train timing leaves less ferry margin.

itinerary.title: TurboJET Sheung Wan → Macau Outer Harbour
itinerary.transportInstructions: Take the 07:30 ferry to Outer Harbour. Sunday uses weekend fare. Be at the terminal at least 30 minutes before departure.

details.crowdNote: Sunday can be busier than Monday. Prebook and keep the early sailing to stay ahead of day-trip crowds.

itinerary.title: Macau immigration and arrival buffer
itinerary.transportInstructions: Clear immigration, verify mobile data/roaming and keep passports accessible.

itinerary.title: Walk to Macau Fisherman's Wharf
itinerary.transportInstructions: Fisherman's Wharf is beside the Outer Harbour terminal.

transportOptions.name: Taxi
transportOptions.route: Outer Harbour Ferry Terminal → Fisherman's Wharf
transportOptions.notes: Unnecessary unless mobility or weather makes walking inconvenient.

details.quickNote: Quick waterfront / Roman-style photo stop. Do not let this eat into the historic-centre morning.

itinerary.title: Fisherman's Wharf → Senado Square
itinerary.transportInstructions: Use a metered taxi to save time. Macau taxi fares are regulated; ask the driver to use the meter.

transportOptions.name: Public bus
transportOptions.route: Outer Harbour/NAPE area → central Macau; choose the live route with the shortest walk
transportOptions.notes: Cheaper but slower and less predictable on a Sunday.

transportOptions.route: Use a convenient free shuttle toward central Macau, then walk
transportOptions.notes: Only if the route actually helps; do not detour for a free ride.

itinerary.title: Walk to Ruins of St Paul's via historic streets
itinerary.transportInstructions: Walk through pedestrian streets, bakeries, almond-cookie and snack shops.

itinerary.title: Macanese / Portuguese lunch
itinerary.transportInstructions: Keep lunch efficient near the historic centre. Portuguese-style chicken, pork, seafood or Macanese rice; try a Portuguese egg tart and/or pork chop bun. No beef.

itinerary.title: Historic centre → Macau Tower
itinerary.transportInstructions: This leg protects the Bungy booking. Use a metered taxi rather than a slow bus.

transportOptions.name: Public bus
transportOptions.notes: Use only if comfortably ahead of the Bungy check-in time.

details.crowdNote: Sunday traffic can add delay. Leave immediately after lunch.

itinerary.title: Macau Tower and Bungy block
itinerary.transportInstructions: Allow full block for registration, weighing, briefing, equipment, waiting, jump, photos/video and observation. Bungy cost intentionally excluded from budget.

details.quickNote: Target the 14:00–14:30 booking and arrive at least 30 minutes early. Keep the full block for registration, waiting, jump, photos/video and observation.

itinerary.title: Macau Tower → Studio City / Cotai
itinerary.transportInstructions: Use taxi for the Peninsula → Cotai jump. This is where public buses can cost too much time.

transportOptions.name: Public bus
transportOptions.notes: Not recommended on this time-sensitive day.

itinerary.title: Golden Reel at Studio City
itinerary.transportInstructions: Optional only. Skip immediately if Bungy runs late or you want more relaxed time in the major resorts.

details.fallback: Skip Golden Reel first; protect Venetian, Londoner/Parisian and Wynn Palace at night.

transportOptions.name: Public bus
transportOptions.route: Macau Tower area → Cotai / Studio City

transportOptions.name: Skip Golden Reel and taxi directly to Venetian
transportOptions.notes: Best fallback if Bungy runs late.

transportOptions.name: Walk / resort connection
transportOptions.route: Studio City → Venetian/Cotai Strip if doing Golden Reel first

transportOptions.name: Free resort shuttle
transportOptions.route: Use only if a convenient direct shuttle is available

itinerary.transportInstructions: Walk/short internal Cotai transfer from Studio City area. See the Grand Canal/Shoppes and spend ~10–15 minutes inside the casino floor if interested.

itinerary.transportInstructions: Wynn Palace is nearby in Cotai; use the fastest practical option rather than waiting a long time for a shuttle.

transportOptions.name: Walk

transportOptions.notes: Do not wait around just to save a short taxi fare.

itinerary.title: Wynn Palace Performance Lake + SkyCab if time

details.attractionCost: Performance Lake free; SkyCab currently complimentary
details.quickNote: At night the Performance Lake currently runs every 20 minutes. On Sundays SkyCab currently runs until 22:00 with last entry 21:40.
details.priorityRule: Fountain first. SkyCab only if the queue is reasonable.

itinerary.title: Dinner in Cotai
itinerary.transportInstructions: Eat at Wynn Palace or nearby Cotai depending queues. Keep dinner to ~40 minutes to protect the 23:00 ferry.

itinerary.title: Wynn Palace → Taipa Ferry Terminal
itinerary.transportInstructions: Do not rely on a long shuttle chain this late. Use taxi unless a direct shuttle is immediately available.

transportOptions.name: Taxi

transportOptions.name: Resort shuttle

transportOptions.notes: Do not wait and risk the ferry.

transportOptions.name: Public bus
transportOptions.notes: Fallback only.

details.quickNote: Use the buffer for ticketing/check-in, immigration, toilets and snacks. If the evening finishes early, ask about an earlier sailing only if convenient; do not depend on it.

itinerary.title: Cotai Water Jet Taipa → Hong Kong Sheung Wan
itinerary.transportInstructions: Prebook the 23:00 Taipa → Sheung Wan Cotai Water Jet. Current schedule also lists 22:00 and 23:59, but recheck December service before booking.

transportOptions.name: Cotai Water Jet 22:00

itinerary.title: Return to hotel after Macau
itinerary.transportInstructions: After arriving Sheung Wan around midnight, use taxi to Yau Ma Tei rather than adding another transfer.

transportOptions.name: Taxi

transportOptions.name: MTR
transportOptions.notes: Use only if service is still operating and you are not exhausted.

itinerary.title: Luk On Kui old-school dim sum
itinerary.transportInstructions: Yau Ma Tei → Central → Sheung Wan, then walk. Try har gow, siu mai, char siu bao, cheung fun, ribs, turnip cake and tea.

transportOptions.name: MTR + walk
transportOptions.route: Yau Ma Tei → Central/Sheung Wan, then walk to Luk On Kui

transportOptions.name: Bus

itinerary.title: Walk Luk On Kui → Man Mo Temple
itinerary.transportInstructions: Walk uphill along/near Hollywood Road; pay attention to street names as GPS orientation can be confusing.

transportOptions.name: Taxi

itinerary.title: Man Mo Temple

details.quickNote: Traditional temple dedicated to Man Cheong (literature) and Mo Tai (war). Allow a short cultural visit; respect worshippers and do not block prayers.

itinerary.title: Travel Man Mo Temple → Wong Tai Sin Temple

importantNotes.title: Arrival at Hong Kong Airport
importantNotes.summary: Withdraw only a small amount of HKD if needed. Do not exchange a large amount at the airport.
importantNotes.body:
Clear immigration.
Collect luggage.
Activate SIM → complete registration → verify mobile data.
Withdraw only a small amount of HKD if needed.
Take A21 and pay contactless if Octopus is not ready.
Check in.
After check-in, buy two On-Loan Octopus cards at Yau Ma Tei MTR.

importantNotes.title: No beef / no beef broth
importantNotes.summary: Show this phrase when soup or noodles are unclear.
importantNotes.copyText: 唔要牛肉，唔要牛湯。豬肉、雞肉、海鮮都可以。
importantNotes.pronunciation: m4 jiu3 ngau4 juk6, m4 jiu3 ngau4 tong1. zyu1 juk6, gai1 juk6, hoi2 sin1 dou1 ho2 ji5.
importantNotes.meaning: No beef, no beef broth. Pork, chicken and seafood are okay.
importantNotes.body: Use this when soup or noodle broth is unclear. Ask the restaurant to confirm before ordering.

importantNotes.body: Use this for everyday service, such as when someone brings food or gives directions.

importantNotes.title: Excuse me / sorry

importantNotes.body: Useful when navigating a busy restaurant or asking someone for help.

importantNotes.title: Where is the toilet?
importantNotes.summary: A practical question while out.

importantNotes.title: Payments
importantNotes.summary: Octopus → transit and small purchases · card → larger purchases · cash → backup
importantNotes.body: Use physical Octopus for MTR, buses, Ding Ding, Star Ferry, convenience stores and small purchases. Use card for larger meals, tickets and shopping. Keep HK$1,500–2,000 total cash as a backup for markets, street food, Tai O and older restaurants.

importantNotes.title: ATM
importantNotes.summary: Choose HKD · decline INR conversion / DCC
importantNotes.body: Use a debit or forex card at an ATM with reasonable overseas fees. Never use a normal credit card for cash unless its terms explicitly allow it. At an ATM or card terminal, always choose HKD and decline INR conversion, guaranteed INR amount, or ATM conversion.

importantNotes.title: Octopus
importantNotes.summary: Transit and small purchases; keep enough balance for the day.
importantNotes.body: Starts with about HK$150 stored value. Top up another HK$250–350 if needed. Reload at MTR stations or supported convenience stores.

importantNotes.title: Getting around
importantNotes.summary: Google Maps = where · operator app = when · check MTR exit letter
importantNotes.body: Find the destination in Google Maps. Check the operator app for live vehicle timing. In dense areas, confirm the MTR exit letter or stop name before walking away.

importantNotes.title: Macau day essentials
importantNotes.summary: Passport · MOP cash · roaming · ferry confirmation
importantNotes.body: Carry your passport. Enable Macau roaming. Carry small MOP cash. Confirm ferry details. Do not assume a standard Hong Kong Adult On-Loan Octopus works on Macau buses; use cards for larger purchases where accepted.

importantNotes.title: Macau Money / Transport Payments
importantNotes.summary: Small MOP cash · Buses: MOP 6 exact—no change · MOP 1/2/5 + MOP 10 · LRT machines: MOP cash only · Counter: HKD/cards; change MOP · Ask for MOP change from HKD · Zero-forex card for larger payments · HKD backup; MOP for small transport
importantNotes.body:
• Carry some MOP cash, especially small notes and coins.
• Public buses cost MOP 6; pay exact MOP cash where possible—no change is given.
• Keep MOP 1, 2 and 5 coins plus MOP 10 notes ready.
• LRT ticket and top-up machines use MOP cash only.
• LRT customer service counters may accept HKD or cards, but cash change is returned in MOP.
• If paying HKD cash at a shop or restaurant, ask for MOP change to build small change.
• Prefer the zero-forex card for larger payments.
• Keep HKD as backup, but use MOP for small transport payments when practical.

importantNotes.title: Mobile data & roaming
importantNotes.summary: Verify data, Maps, WhatsApp, transport apps and TripBoard on both phones.
importantNotes.body: SoSIM for both phones requires real-name registration. Keep Jio available for OTPs or calls where roaming permits. Buy the Greater China one-day Macau roaming package before the Macau day.

importantNotes.title: Useful apps
importantNotes.summary: Citybus · KMB / APP1933 · MTR Mobile · Maps · WhatsApp
importantNotes.body: Citybus: bus information. KMB / APP1933: KMB buses. HK Tramways: trams. MTR Mobile: MTR. Google Maps: navigation. WhatsApp: communication.

importantNotes.title: Emergency
importantNotes.summary: Police · fire · ambulance: 999
importantNotes.body: For police, fire services, or an ambulance in Hong Kong, dial 999.

importantNotes.title: Transport planning assumptions
importantNotes.summary: Fares and journey times are approximate; recheck holiday operations before travel.
importantNotes.body: Transport fares and journey times are approximate planning values based on information available in September 2026. Recheck MTR, bus, ferry, Peak Tram and holiday/NYE operations shortly before travel.
